proposition: POST /api/v1/management/bridges: contract says Bridge.persist is nullable; implementation does pass its Boolean value directly to a primitive boolean builder parameter.

target.direction: nullable Boolean passed to primitive boolean

mandatory_search.reason: §11.4.1 deterministic unboxing crash, subject to verifying validation/defaults and mapper.

decision.rationale: Nullable persist is unboxed into a primitive without validation or fallback. Null therefore reaches an internal-error path; §9.3 R1 attributes this to implementation. Persist is neither a resource key nor a mandatory persistent field.
decision.details: Explicit null witness; no reliance on generated DTO missing-field default. validateBridge :310-327 has no persist guard. Builder default true :158 permits handling null without requiring a spec change. §10.6 does not require both_candidate for this optional flag.
